parameters.query: select coalesce((select (value #>> '{}')::float from app.settings where key = 'router.min_confidence'), 0.6) as min_confidence, (select value #>> '{}' from app.settings where key = 'services.text_url') as text_url

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $('Validate body').first().json.text, mask: true, use_ner: true }) }}
